name: monaco-viewer
description: Chrome extension to view code files with Monaco Editor

scripts.build: rm -rf .build monaco-viewer.zip && mkdir .build && cp -R src .build/monaco-viewer && cd .build && zip -rq ../monaco-viewer.zip monaco-viewer -x '*.DS_Store' '*/_metadata/*' && cd .. && rm -rf .build
